lines.2: 「I sent him out on a roadwork run toward the station.」
lines.3: 「The station, huh...? Bet he's slacking off.」
lines.4: 「Might as well check on him while I get my own run in.」
lines.7: Well, I guess somebody somewhere must be bad-mouthing me.
lines.8: Still, even if this is for conditioning, why do I have to go running?
